reason: I might let them do the free audit if I had a quiet afternoon, but I do the billing myself every month and I know my clients. I'm not signing up for £99 a month for a check I already do with a spreadsheet.
objection: It finds a few licences and some unbilled hours the first time, I fix my process, and then I'm paying £1,200 a year for a report that says nothing new. Plus I'm handing a stranger my PSA export and contracts.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the free audit actually turn up a few thousand a year I'd missed, and then a couple of months where the monthly check kept catching new stuff before I invoiced.
